book1.title: Book 1: War of Darkness
paragraphs: Long ago, the continent of Archanea was invaded by the Dolhr Empire, led by the king of the Manaketes (dragon people), Medeus. The people lived in fear and despair.
The Holy Kingdom of Archanea, which had always protected the world, was also destroyed by the horrific power of the Shadow Dragon. The world was on the verge of destruction.

However... A miracle occurred. Anri, a young man from the rural town of Altea, went on a perilous journey to obtain the divine sword of light, Falchion. He used it to challenge and defeat the Shadow Dragon, Medeus.

With Medeus's fall, the Dolhr Empire was vanquished, and The Kingdom of Archanea was rebuilt. The world entered an age of peace, and many nations, including the Kingdom of Altea, were newly established.
100 years after the war, Medeus resurrected at Dolhr. He allied with the neighboring kingdoms of Grust and Macedon, rebuilding the Dolhr Empire.
He also joined forces with Khadein's Pontifex Gharnef, who shared the same ambitions of ruling the world as him, and launched an attack on the Kingdom of Archanea.
Archanea desperately defended itself, but suffered repeated defeats against the power of Medeus and Grust's renowned general Camus. Aside from Princess Nyna, the entire royal family was wiped out.

King Cornelius of Altea, who possessed the bloodline of Anri, set out to defeat Medeus. He took the Falchion, the divine sword of legend, to battle, but was betrayed by Altea's ally, Gra, and died in battle. Following his demise, the Kingdom of Altea also fell.
Prince Marth, just 14 years of age, managed to escape with the help of his older sister, Princess Elice. He fled to the remote island nation of Talys...

book2.title: Book 2: War of Heroes
paragraphs: After five long years of suffering, the great war with the Dolhr Empire, which would later be called the War of Darkness, came to an end with the defeat of the Earth Dragon King Medeus.
The warriors who had gathered under the Fire Emblem returned to their respective countries and dedicated their efforts to rebuilding their devastated homelands.

Among the countries once called the seven kingdoms of Archanea, Gra and Grust were ruined. Altea, Aurelis, Macedon, and Talys were deeply scarred. The great Kingdom of Archanea was also in the process of reconstruction.
At the royal capital of Pales, which was still shaken by the war, a significant event occurred. King Aurelis' younger brother, Hardin, married Princess Nyna and ascended as the 24th King of Archanea.

After becoming king, Hardin, through seemingly forceful methods, quickly restored the nation's strength. He gathered many soldiers to create a powerful army. Following that, he declared the restoration of the Holy Empire of Archanea, and declared himself Emperor.
One year after the end of the war with Dolhr, the world seemed to be entering a state of peace. However, the wheel of fortune started to turn anew...
